title: Kii Magaca Lahaa Ee Ku Jiray Qoyska Nabiga
intro: Guriga rasuulkii ugu dambeeyay, waxaa ku noolaa naf sheekadeeda shaqsiyeed ay cashar rabbaani ah u noqotay dhammaan mu'miniinta. Nolosha qofkan waxay si dhow ula xiriirtay amar isbeddel ah oo dib u habeeyey caadooyinka bulshada weligeed, taasoo calaamad u ah isbeddel qoto dheer oo ku yimid sida iimaanku u qeexi doono qoyska iyo lahaanshaha.
clues: Magacaygu mar wuxuu la xiriiray abtirsiin sharaf leh, laakiin run sare ayaa markii dambe caddayn doonta isku xirnaanta runta ah ee iimaanka.
Waxaan ahaa mid ka helay nimco weyn oo ka timid Alle iyo rasuulkiisa, waana nimco si cad loogu sheegay Kitaabka.
Noloshayda guurku waxay noqotay imtixaan muhiim ah oo weligiis beddeli doona aragtida xiriirka la korsaday.
Aniga ayaa ahaa qofkii dacwaddiisa shaqsiyeed ay keentay amar rabbaani ah oo u oggolaaday Nabiga inuu guursado haweeney ka dib markii aan baxay.
Sheekadayda, kala duwanaanshaha qoyska bayoolojiga ah iyo kan la doortay ayaa si cad loo muujiyay jiilalka oo dhan.
Aniga kaliya ayaan ahay qofka keliya ee asxaabteyda ah oo magaciisa si cad uga muuqda waxyigii ugu dambeeyay, oo aan ahayn nebi, laakiin sidii addoon la tijaabiyey oo la sharfay.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
